name: trebol-infographics-suite
description: Suite de infografías técnicas animadas de 10s con HyperFrames y Trebol Design System

scripts.render:all: npm run render:1 && npm run render:2 && npm run render:3 && npm run render:4
scripts.render:1: npx hyperframes render -c infografia_1_writing_process.html -o renders/infografia_01_writing_process.mp4 --fps 30 --format mp4
scripts.render:2: npx hyperframes render -c infografia_2_agentic_flow.html -o renders/infografia_02_agentic_flow.mp4 --fps 30 --format mp4
scripts.render:3: npx hyperframes render -c infografia_3_rl_vs_imitation.html -o renders/infografia_03_rl_vs_imitation.mp4 --fps 30 --format mp4

author: Trebol Design & Engineering
